limitations: The rule concerns a single volatile variable and a happens-before edge. It does not make a sequence of accesses atomic or say that every later read returns this particular write's value.

triggers: Exact-edition correction, retrieval identity change, or material scope challenge.

statement: In the Java SE 21 memory model, a write to a volatile field happens-before each read of the same field variable that follows the write in synchronization order.
